name: feedback-11-load-time-traceability
body: source: section-helpers/feedback-11 (final implementation review, traceability divergence) on requirements.requirement.raw-source-context. Inconsistency: raw-source-context, section-data-context and section-helper reached only solution.component.renderer (internal/render/render.go) and, for section-helper, solution.component.slide-parser; their load-time (templates-dir-validation step 7) counterparts in internal/template/examplecheck.go (exampleRawContext, exampleDataContext, exampleSectionHelper, checkLibraryExample) and internal/template/section.go (ResolveSectionCall, SectionCall, HelperCall, Section.HelperCalls, Section.HelperRefs) belong to solution.component.template-library-loader / solution.component.template-registry, which were not on those requirements' spines. Also, solution.component.agent-guide anchored only internal/scaffold/libraryguide.go, not the guide sources internal/scaffold/seed/AGENTS.md and internal/scaffold/libraryguide/AGENTS.md or the drift test internal/scaffold/agentsguide_test.go. Resolution [with user, per coordinator instruction]: added drives requirements.requirement.raw-source-context -> domain.service.load-template-library, requirements.requirement.section-data-context -> domain.service.load-template-library, requirements.requirement.section-helper -> domain.service.load-template-library and requirements.requirement.section-helper -> domain.service.template-registry (both services are realised-by the components above); added implemented-by solution.component.template-library-loader -> exampleRawContext, exampleDataContext, exampleSectionHelper, checkLibraryExample; implemented-by solution.component.template-registry -> ResolveSectionCall, SectionCall, HelperCall, Section.HelperCalls, Section.HelperRefs; implemented-by solution.component.agent-guide -> internal/scaffold/seed/AGENTS.md, internal/scaffold/libraryguide/AGENTS.md, internal/scaffold/agentsguide_test.go. Every code/file endpoint was resolved in the graph before the edge was added. This supersedes requirements.note.agent-guide-test-anchor-removed: the drift-test file is re-anchored because the final review asked for it and the scanner classifies internal/scaffold/agentsguide_test.go and every unit in it as code_type src, not test. The render-time spur (renderer/slide-parser) documented by the existing drives edges is unchanged.
